servers.description: vidlizer pulls frames out of any video, image, or PDF using ffmpeg, sends them to a vision LLM, and returns a flow array — one entry per scene. Each entry tells you what happened, who was on screen, what text was visible, and what changed. If the video has audio, it transcribes it with Apple MLX Whisper and merges the speech into each step.

PROVIDER.description: Provider to use: ollama, openai, openrouter

BATCH_SIZE.description: Frames per API call (0 = auto, defaults to 1)

MAX_FRAMES.description: Max frames to send (default 60, hard cap 200)

OPENAI_MODEL.description: Model ID as shown in server (required)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible server (e.g., lm-studio or not-needed)

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible server (e.g., http://localhost:1234/v1)
